shortDescription: Manage the SSHD settings of a BIG-IP

options.name: allow
options.description: If you have enabled SSH access, specifies the IP address or address range for other systems that can use SSH to communicate with this system. To specify all addresses, use the value C(all). An IP address can be specified, such as 172.27.1.10. IP ranges can be specified, such as 172.27.*.* or 172.27.0.0/255.255.0.0. To remove SSH access, specify an empty list or an empty string.

options.name: banner
options.description: Whether to enable the banner or not.

options.name: banner_text
options.description: Specifies the text to include on the pre-login banner, which displays when a user attempts to login to the system using SSH.

options.name: inactivity_timeout
options.description: Specifies the number of seconds before inactivity causes an SSH session to log out.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Specifies the minimum SSHD message level to include in the system log.

options.name: login
options.description: When checked C(enabled), specifies the system accepts SSH communication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port on which you want the SSH daemon to run.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
